text:
maya: Quick sync — accessibility + fallback plan for Thurs webinar. Two asks: captions/transcript workflow and who flips to prerecorded demo. Can everyone confirm availability for a 15m dry-run at T-45?
aj: Available for T-45. For captions, do we use live auto-captions or vendor captions?
lexi: Recommend vendor captions for accuracy. We can do auto as backup but need timecode-aligned SRT upload after recording.
maya: Good. Lexi, can you own vendor order + turnaround (24h target)?
lexi: I can. Will send PO and share contact in #marketing-tasks. Need event uid and expected runtime.
kim: Runtime = 60m. Also request live caption stream (WebVTT) to attach during broadcast. Opsbot, is WebVTT hooked to the streaming infra?
opsbot: caption-service: enabled on staging; endpoint ws://captions.staging.redwood.ai/vtt; token required. status=healthy
sam: On demo fallback: we have a 4min recorded walkthrough for the core feature. Plan: if avg token latency > 6s or 5% error rate for 2+ minutes, we swap to recording. Who's gatekeeper?
aj: Host should trigger, but need admin toggle and ops backup. I'll add maya and sam to webcast-admin group.
aj: Command to add user: `rctl grants create --role webcast-admin --user sam`
maya: I'll be host + can flip if needed. Sam, can you set an alert to ping #marketing with latency spikes?
sam: Setting up a small monitor that posts to Slack. Script below.
sam: ```python
import requests
# poll /metrics/demo latency, post to slack if avg > 6
```
kim: Also: accessibility checklist — live alt text for any images, slide notes in deck, and transcript distribution policy. We should publish transcript within 24h and 30s highlight clips within 48h.
lexi: Good call. I'll add clip editing to the vendor scope. Also need speaker consent for clips — maya, can you get signed permission?
maya: I'll DM speakers and add a checkbox in speaker prep doc.
aj: Networking / demo access: confirm VPC peering + signed certs for staging S3 access. Opsbot showed peering ok last week, but re-check now.
opsbot: peering-check: status=ok, last-verified=2026-04-03T15:04:12Z. certs: active for demo.redwood.ai (expires 2026-09-01)
sam: Token TTL: default 90m. Set for webinar to end + 45m buffer. I'll create token with exp claim accordingly.
sam: curl example: ```bash
curl -XPOST https://auth.redwood.ai/token -d '{"scope":"webinar"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SEED'
```
kim: Run order reminder: T-60 panel joins, T-15 mic check & slides, T-5 host intro, 0 go live. Demo at 18m mark. Please ensure slide handoff notes are slide numbers not names.
maya: I'll update run-of-show with slide numbers and upload link. Also renumber slides so the host can click through if presenter drops.
aj: Backup presenter: @lexi will do demo if primary drops out? Lexi: can you run a 10m dry demo tomorrow?
lexi: Yes, I can. Will rehearse with staging token.
sam: One more: analytics hooks — ensure event names for: demo_started, demo_fallback_triggered, recording_played. I'll wire them to the webinar dashboard.
maya: Perfect. Final checks: Lexi owns vendor captions, Sam owns tokens + monitors, AJ owns admin grants, Kim owns accessibility checklist, Opsbot reconfirms infra. Dry-run T-45 (15m) at 2026-04-10T09:15:00Z.
opsbot: calendar-invite: created (participants: maya, aj, sam, kim, lexi), reminder=15m before
maya: Thanks all — I'll post final run-of-show link here when done.
